programs.title: Secrets in a Small Town
programs.desc: A mother's worst nightmare comes true when her teenaged daughter goes missing.

programs.title: The Secrets She Keeps
programs.desc: Unhappy with her daughter's new boyfriend, a woman digs deep into his past and discovers he's every mother's worst nightmare.

programs.title: Drowning in Secrets
programs.desc: A day out on the water takes an unsettling turn as a young woman goes missing under mysterious circumstances. Determined to find her, the woman's sister returns home in a search for clues that could lead to the truth of her sister's disappearance.

programs.title: Secrets Exposed
programs.desc: Single mom Joanna wants to surprise her daughter, Lizzie, at college, but when she arrives on campus, Joanna learns Lizzie is missing. She learns Lizzie has a job as a cam girl and that Lizzie's co-worker was killed in her apartment.

programs.title: Secrets in the Family
programs.desc: Ana is a nurse struggling to pay for school. When she comes across a lucrative job caring for Joan, a woman struggling with dementia, Ana is intrigued. When Joan tells Ana she thinks someone is trying to kill her, Ana dismisses Joan's claim as paranoia. As strange things begin to happen and lead to Joan's sudden death, all signs point to Ana as making one too many careless mistakes.

programs.title: Secrets in the Building
programs.desc: Following the death of her husband, Michelle and her daughter, Norah, move into a new condo for a fresh start. However, they soon face mysterious threats from an unknown culprit who wants them out of the building.
